description.value: The study used voxel-based morphometry and resting-state functional connectivity to identify gray matter deficits and functional abnormalities in abstinent heroin-dependent individuals and examine their associations with duration of heroin use.

spans.text: The purposes of the present study were to (1) identify brain regions with gray matter density reduction in heroin-dependent individuals employing voxel-based morphometry; (2) investigate the clinical significance of gray matter density reduction and functional connectivity of these anatomic deficits by focusing on their association with duration of heroin use.

description.value: Observational, cross-sectional comparison of abstinent heroin-dependent individuals and healthy subjects, with clinical associations examined using duration of heroin use.
